name: EPIC 205992575
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.1 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205992575 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.125226 (16th-84th percentiles 8.979437-9.318054), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205992575: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4996.325 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205992575 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4086.25 (16th-84th percentiles 4032.929688-4145.742188), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,086 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,996 K at its surface.
